text: {"rules":[{"id":"BRCA-RISK-MED-35","version":"September 2019","title":"Breast Cancer: Medication Use to Reduce Risk: women at increased risk for breast cancer aged 35 years or older","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends that clinicians offer to prescribe risk-reducing medications, such as tamoxifen, raloxifene, or aromatase inhibitors, to women who are at increased risk for breast cancer and at low risk for adverse medication effects.","grade":"B","effective_date":"September 2019","action":"Offer to prescribe risk-reducing medication (e.g., tamoxifen, raloxifene, or aromatase inhibitors) to eligible women","denominator":"{\"all\": [{\"sex\": {\"is\": \"F\"}, \"quote\": \"women\"}, {\"age\": {\"min\": 35, \"at\": \"end\"}, \"quote\": \"aged 35 years or older\"}, {\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"breast cancer risk assessment (e.g., family history, risk model score) establishing increased risk\"}, \"quote\": \"women who are at increased risk for breast cancer\"}, {\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"clinician judgment that patient is at low risk for adverse medication effects\"}, \"quote\": \"at low risk for adverse medication effects\"}]}","numerator":"{\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"documentation that clinician offered risk-reducing medication (shared decision making about tamoxifen, raloxifene, or aromatase inhibitors)\"}, \"quote\": \"offer to prescribe risk-reducing medications, such as tamoxifen, raloxifene, or aromatase inhibitors\"}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["The age criterion (35 years or older) is quoted from the TOPIC field; the DESCRIPTION sentence itself does not state an age.","Increased breast cancer risk and low risk of adverse medication effects require risk assessment and clinician judgment; they are encoded as uncomputable rather than approximated.","The numerator ('offer to prescribe') is a shared-decision-making action and is uncomputable. No vocabulary concept exists for tamoxifen, raloxifene, or aromatase inhibitor prescriptions. A prescription alone would not capture an offer that was declined, so no medication concept was invented.","Medication choice, dosing, duration, and specific adverse-effect contraindications (e.g., thromboembolic history) are not specified in the section and are not represented.","The DATE field carries an asterisk ('September 2019 *') whose meaning is not given in the section text; it is not represented."]}
